stories.title: useProData accepts `enabled` parameter and defers fetch when disabled
acceptanceCriteria: useProData signature accepts an options object with `enabled` (default true)
When enabled=false, no fetch effect runs and hook returns { loading:false, data:null, error:null }
When enabled=true, existing behavior is preserved (fetches ingredients + pairings + augments + chemDataset as today)
All existing call sites continue working without passing enabled (backwards-compatible default)
Flipping enabled from false to true triggers the fetch exactly once

stories.title: StartPage component with 3 mode cards + spec copy + polished per-card visuals
acceptanceCriteria: src/components/StartPage.jsx exists and exports default a React component accepting `{ onModeSelect }` prop
Renders title 'Find flavors that work together.' and subtitle mentioning '2.2M recipes' and 'real molecular chemistry'
Renders exactly 3 mode cards with spec copy: Discover / Build / Learn (labels and descriptions per spec line 141-145)
Discover card shows a CSS-only animated node-cluster (6-8 glowing dots with connection lines, gentle pulse)
Build card shows an SVG icon composite (recipe list + cocktail glass + sauce bowl)
Learn card shows a rotating molecule (CSS-rotated SVG or minimal Three.js reuse)
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables animation on Discover and Learn cards (static fallback)
Clicking a card invokes onModeSelect('discover'|'build'|'learn') with the correct mode id
Clicking a card sets localStorage['fn-start-seen']='1' (wrapped in try/catch for private-mode Safari)
At ≤375px viewport cards stack vertically; at ≥768px cards render 3-column
Tab cycles through the 3 cards; Enter on focused card activates it
No 27MB payload is fetched while StartPage is mounted and user has not clicked a card

stories.title: App.jsx mounts StartPage before useProData, gates by localStorage, supports ?reset=start
acceptanceCriteria: App.jsx reads localStorage.getItem('fn-start-seen') at mount to derive startPageComplete
When URL contains ?reset=start, App.jsx calls localStorage.removeItem('fn-start-seen') before reading flag
When !startPageComplete and !modeSelected, App.jsx renders <StartPage/> and useProData is called with enabled=false
When a mode card is clicked, App.jsx: sets modeSelected, sets localStorage fn-start-seen=1, switches active tab to the chosen surface, useProData is called with enabled=true which triggers fetch
Discover mode routes to Network tab; Build routes to Recipe Lab (default sub-tab Recipe); Learn routes to Molecule Lab with HowItWorks modal auto-opened
On returning visit with fn-start-seen=1 present, StartPage does NOT render and useProData fetches eagerly as before
Existing Walkthrough.jsx (`flavor-tour-complete`) flow is unaffected

stories.title: ErrorCard with Retry + Start Over on post-CTA fetch failure
acceptanceCriteria: When useProData.error is set after mode selection, App.jsx renders an ErrorCard in place of the loading spinner
ErrorCard shows exact copy: 'Couldn't load the flavor network.'
ErrorCard renders two buttons: Retry and Start over
Retry re-invokes the fetch (forces useProData to re-run its effect) and preserves fn-start-seen=1
Start over calls localStorage.removeItem('fn-start-seen'), resets modeSelected state, and unmounts the ErrorCard so StartPage re-renders
ErrorCard and Retry/Start-over affordances do not render on the happy path

stories.title: StartPage unit tests cover happy path, reduced-motion, and error-path
acceptanceCriteria: StartPage.test.jsx exists colocated with StartPage.jsx (matches project convention: TasteWheel.test.jsx is also colocated, not in __tests__/)
Test: each card click sets localStorage['fn-start-seen']='1' and fires onModeSelect with the correct mode id
Test: under matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') returning matches=true, the animated node-cluster and rotating molecule render their static fallbacks
Test: keyboard Tab reaches each card; Enter on focused card fires onModeSelect

Test: App-level flow: after mode click with forced fetch failure, ErrorCard renders with correct copy and Retry button; Retry button re-invokes fetch; Start over clears localStorage and restores StartPage
npx vitest run src/ passes with zero failures
